digest.overview: A narrow 5-hour window delivered Anthropic's $10B cloud deal, fresh open-weight releases including Ling-3.0-flash MoE, regulatory heat on Texas data centers, and local runnable MiniMax-H3 video model notes. Big-lab spending and open-model momentum from non-US players stood out.

top_story.headline: Anthropic inks $10B deal with AI cloud startup Volta
top_story.summary: Anthropic continues its cloud partnership spree with a reported $10 billion agreement for AI infrastructure.
top_story.why_it_matters: Signals escalating hyperscale spend amid capacity constraints; follows recent Anthropic moves with other providers.

sentiment.label: mixed
sentiment.summary: Community notes strong open-model progress from inclusionAI and others alongside regulatory friction on data centers and questions about unsustainable demand.

model_releases.headline: inclusionAI releases Ling-3.0-flash weights (MIT, 127.5B total / 5.1B active MoE)
model_releases.summary: Official BF16 and FP8 weights now on Hugging Face; 512 experts, fine-grained routing for agentic and high-volume tasks.

model_releases.headline: Liquid AI ships LFM2.5-2.6B with agentic focus
model_releases.summary: New small model emphasizes agent capabilities for high-volume document tasks; follows their earlier efficient releases.

frontier_labs.headline: Nvidia-backed Open Secure AI Alliance issues first proposals on defending against AI agents
frontier_labs.summary: Week-old group of 120+ companies already releasing defense specs; Nvidia driving rapid progress.

frontier_labs.headline: NVIDIA joins NSF State and Regional AI Hubs to expand US research access
frontier_labs.summary: Partnership aims to broaden advanced compute, data and expertise for AI education and R&D beyond coastal hubs.

influencer_takes.author: Simon Willison
influencer_takes.quote: The MiniMax-H3 video generation model is a lot of fun - here's what I generated on my M5 Pro Mac for the prompt 'a rainbow colored skunk leaps over a mossy log in a supermarket' (~115GB model download, took around 45 minutes)
influencer_takes.context: Demonstrates practical local inference of a new omni-modal video model on consumer hardware

research_radar.headline: When AI Benchmarks Plateau: A Systematic Study of Benchmark Saturation
research_radar.summary: arXiv paper examines saturation effects across popular benchmarks, with HN discussion on evaluation reliability.

post_ideas.hook: Anthropic just dropped another $10B cloud check
post_ideas.draft: Anthropic's latest $10B Volta deal shows the real constraint isn't models anymore—it's who can actually power the inference at scale.
post_ideas.why_viral: Highlights infrastructure bottleneck with concrete dollar figure; taps ongoing capacity anxiety

post_ideas.draft: 127B MoE with only 5B active params, MIT license, FP8 variant ~128GB. Another non-US open model shipping serious capability.
post_ideas.why_viral: Contrarian to US-centric narratives; specific size and licensing details invite immediate experimentation talk

post_ideas.hook: Texas just paused new data centers
post_ideas.draft: Texas halting new AI data center connections for audits is the first real regulatory brake on the buildout. Power reality check arriving.
post_ideas.why_viral: Surprise policy move in a pro-growth state; pairs infrastructure spend stories with concrete limits
